sloka: महर्षिणां वधो घोरः सर्वदेवैश्च विग्रहः।अभिमानश्च कोपश्च वैरित्वं प्रतिकूलता ।। ६.८७.२५ ।।
transliteration: maharṣiṇāṁ vadho ghoraḥ sarvadevaiśca vigrahaḥ।abhimānaśca kopaśca vairitvaṁ pratikūlatā ।। 6.87.25 ।।

translations.english: "Dreadful killing of sages, haughtiness towards deities, irascibility, anger, animosity, refractorinessall these faults will put an end to one's life. These faults have obscured my brother's future just as rainy clouds veil the mountain."
